boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct SMU Libraries environments spanning quiet individual work, group tables, computers, and low-distraction pods.

cards.title: Centennial Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Fondren Library · 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Bring reading-intensive work to the four- and six-person tables; each table has a lamp and electrical outlets.
cards.short_summary: A large, focused quiet room with reference materials at hand.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU describes the Centennial Reading Room as a large, focused quiet-study room with four- and six-person tables, lamps, outlets, and the Fondren reference collection.
cards.access_notes: Open study area; no reservation is needed. Guests are welcome during public access hours; check library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Fondren Library 1st Floor MeSpace Study Pod
cards.title: Fondren MeSpace Study Pod
cards.subtitle: Fondren Library · 1st Floor
cards.notes: Use this one-person pod when you need to cut visual and conversational distractions while working independently.
cards.short_summary: A first-come, first-served single-person focus pod near the first-floor café.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU identifies the Fondren MeSpace as a first-come, first-served study pod designed to limit distractions and support focus.
cards.access_notes: First-come, first-served open study space; plan around Fondren Library access hours.

cards.title: Prothro Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Fondren Library · 1st Floor
cards.notes: Choose a computer desk, casual seat, or large table; use the nearby Print Copy Scan room for output needs.
cards.short_summary: A high-traffic work zone with PC and Mac computers plus varied seating.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU says the Prothro Learning Commons provides PC and Mac computers, casual seating, computer desks, large group tables, and nearby print, scan, and assistive technology.
cards.access_notes: Open study area with conversation allowed; plan around Fondren Library access hours.

cards.entity_name: Fondren Library Research & Scholarly Initiatives Studio
cards.title: Research & Scholarly Initiatives Studio
cards.subtitle: Fondren Library · Room 106, 1st Floor Learning Commons
cards.notes: Set up GIS, projection, or whiteboard work here when workshops and consultations are not using Room 106.
cards.short_summary: A technology-equipped room for research projects and visual collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU states that Room 106 has GIS computers, a projector, whiteboards, seating, and worktables, and students may use it outside workshops and consultations.
cards.access_notes: Students may use the space when workshops and consultations are not in session; check Fondren Library hours.

cards.title: Fondren Fourth Floor
cards.subtitle: Fondren Library · 4th Floor
cards.notes: Pick a carrel, small table, high-top, or casual seat for quiet work with views across campus.
cards.short_summary: Fondren's quietest floor, with several seating formats and campus views.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU calls Fondren's fourth floor its quietest floor and lists small tables, study carrels, high-top seating, casual seating, and campus views.
cards.access_notes: Open study area; plan around Fondren Library access hours.

cards.entity_name: Hamon Arts Library 1st Floor MeSpace Study Pod
cards.title: Hamon MeSpace Study Pod
cards.subtitle: Hamon Arts Library · 1st Floor
cards.notes: Claim this first-come pod for a focused solo session when a standard table leaves too many distractions.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, single-person concentration pod in Hamon Arts Library.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU describes Hamon's first-floor MeSpace as a first-come, first-served study pod for blocking distractions and concentrating.
cards.access_notes: First-come, first-served open study space; plan around Hamon Arts Library access hours.

cards.title: Hamon Study Carrels
cards.subtitle: Hamon Arts Library
cards.notes: Bring multiple devices and use the lighted carrels' power strips for a contained individual work session.
cards.short_summary: Lighted individual carrels with power for several devices.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU lists Hamon Arts Library's study carrels as lighted carrels with power strips for plugging in multiple devices.
cards.access_notes: Open study seating; plan around Hamon Arts Library access hours.

cards.title: Ida Family Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Duda Family Business Library · Lower Level, Cox School of Business
cards.notes: Use the wooden tables and comfortable seating for quiet work; look through the interior windows toward Heppner Commons.
cards.short_summary: A quiet lower-level reading room with tables, interior windows, and distinctive decor.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU describes the Ida Family Reading Room as a quiet lower-level room with wooden study tables, comfortable seating, interior windows, a world map, and international flags.
cards.access_notes: Open study area; plan around Duda Family Business Library access hours.

cards.entity_name: Bridwell Library Methodist Collection Reading Room
cards.title: Methodist Collection Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Bridwell Library · Off the Gill Room
cards.notes: Settle at a large four-person table with a reading lamp and outlet when you need Bridwell's quietest study area.
cards.short_summary: A blue-walled quiet room with windows, lamps, outlets, and large tables.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU calls the Methodist Collection Reading Room Bridwell's quietest study area and notes its windows, four-person tables, reading lamps, and electrical outlets.
cards.access_notes: Open study area; plan around Bridwell Library access hours.

cards.title: Underwood Law Library Third Floor
cards.subtitle: Underwood Law Library · 3rd Floor
cards.notes: Choose a table or other seat near the large windows when daylight helps you sustain a quiet work block.
cards.short_summary: A quiet floor with natural light and multiple seating options.
cards.evidence_claim: SMU describes Underwood Law Library's third floor as a quiet space with large windows, natural light, and a variety of tables and seating options.
cards.access_notes: Open study area; plan around Underwood Law Library access hours.
